description: Speechdub helps you import text into your document library, browse and edit saved documents, and generate natural speech with preset voices. Connect with a Speechdub API key from app.speechdub.com/settings/api. Creating documents uses your document quota; speech synthesis uses the same credit wallet as the web app.

defaultPrompt: List my five most recent saved documents with their titles and languages.
Save this as a new document titled "Morning notes" so I can listen to it later: The lecture covers photosynthesis basics.
Which English voices are available? Pick a calm one and read this aloud: Hello, this is a short listening test.
